description.value: Lakeview Inn & Suites is a full-service hotel in Chetwynd, part of the western Canada Lakeview Hotels and Resorts chain, positioned along the North Access Road in this small Northern BC resource town. It holds a 2-key Green Key Eco-Rating, suggesting a baseline commitment to environmental practices. Touring cyclists passing through Chetwynd — a common stop on routes through the Peace River country — will find a professionally run property with standard hotel amenities.

address.value: 4820 North Access Road, Chetwynd, BC V0C 1J0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the hotel is open and operating at 4820 North Access Road, Chetwynd, BC V0C 1J0, with phone +1 250 788 3000 matching OSM exactly. A guest testimonial mentions a 'breakfast buffet,' confirming breakfast service exists, but no cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, laundry, tools, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content. OSM carries internet_access=wlan but the website text does not explicitly confirm Wi-Fi, so that amenity is left null per the rules.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Lakeview Inn & Suites' (singular) but the website consistently uses 'Lakeview Inns & Suites' (plural). OSM name retained per rules.
Website content is heavily repeated navigation text with minimal property-specific detail, limiting amenity verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel confirmed by active website with matching address and phone; a legitimate overnight option for touring cyclists in Chetwynd.
enrichment_extras.notes: Breakfast buffet mentioned in guest testimonial on website; does not confirm cyclist-specific early or packed breakfast service.
